content.title: SIDEMEN CHARITY MATCH 2026 [OFFICIAL STREAM]
content.text: Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot This helps protect our community. Learn more Sidemen Charity Match 2026 Donate here: https://www.sidemenfc.com On the 18th of April Sidemen FC and YouTube Allstars are coming together to play the 2026 Charity Match at Wembley Stadium. Use the hashtag #SDMNCharityMatch to talk about the game! OFFICIAL STREAM starts at 2:10pm BST Kick off time is at 3pm BST The Charity Match 2026 Beneficiary Charities Google.org and YouTube are committing $3M to youth education and AI skills for teachers in Europe. As part of this commitment, Bright Side will receive $500K to support their work. The charities supported through the Sidemen Charity Match 2026 are: Bright Side (charitable incorporated organisation with registered charity no. 1204201 in England and Wales) and M7 Education (charitable incorporated organisation with registered charity no. 1194248 in England and Wales) Your donations Public donations - made via the Givestar platform at Sidemenfc.com - are split between the charities above in the following portion: Bright Side 86% M7 Education 14% Other Income All of the profit made through the match and related activities will be donated to the following charities: Bright Side 86% M7 Education 14% Any donations you make are greatly appreciated and going to great causes! We hope you enjoy the match. For full details and terms and conditions please visit https://sidemenfc.com
